content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge resolves C4 by noting the targeted curse limb was dropped and no live link remains, not by weighing a live link's pressed witnesses chain against chain.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the witnesses pressed against a link: reading one, any pressing against a target limb invokes K-C even if the defender dropped the limb; reading two, K-C governs only a live link, and a dropped limb leaves no link to weigh.", "why": "The judge disposes of C4 because the curse limb was dropped and no live link remains to contradict, so it neither applies the retired stating-verse test nor weighs a live link verse by verse."}
